query:
SELECT true AS "ok!"
        FROM core.characters c
        JOIN core.character_tokens t ON t.character_id = c.id
        JOIN core.app_characters r ON r.character_id = c.id AND r.plugin_id = $2
        WHERE c.id = $1 AND core.holds_app_permission(c.account_id, $2)
          AND t.state = 'valid'
